scaling_driver:
import sys,os,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from test_surface_compositional_separator import binary
from surface.pr_equilibrium_transport import PREquilibriumNode
from surface.pr_transport_builder import PREquilibriumPipe,build_equilibrium_transport,initialize_grouped
from surface.pr_open_transport import PROpenTransportNetwork,PRTransportFeed,PRTransportPressurePort
from surface.component_energy import ComponentEnergyStream
from surface.torch_backend import runtime_fingerprint
from check_pr_open_transport import audit
from run_dynamic_receiver import fingerprints

dev=sys.argv[1];rows=[];hashes=fingerprints()
for cells,temperature in [(2,320.),(16,320.),(64,320.),(16,196.2)]:
 f=binary(dev)
 t=build_equilibrium_transport(f,[PREquilibriumNode('source',.02),PREquilibriumNode('export',.02)],
  [PREquilibriumPipe('line','source','export',10.,.05,cells)],dense_limit=32,initial_step_s=1e-5,maximum_step_s=1e-5)
 spec={'temperature_k':temperature,'mole_fractions':[.5,.5],'velocity_m_s':0.}
 s=initialize_grouped(t,{'source':{**spec,'pressure_pa':1e6},'export':{**spec,'pressure_pa':990000.},'line':{**spec,'pressure_pa':995000.}})
 stream=ComponentEnergyStream.from_pt(f,[.01,.02],1010000.,temperature+1.,gravity_m_s2=t.gravity_m_s2)
 m=PROpenTransportNetwork(t,[PRTransportFeed('feed','source',stream)],[PRTransportPressurePort('out','export',985000.,temperature,(.5,.5),1e-9)])
 if dev=='cuda':torch.cuda.synchronize()
 start=time.perf_counter();r=m.advance(s,1e-5)
 if dev=='cuda':torch.cuda.synchronize()
 elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
 a=audit(m.to_dict(),s.to_dict(),r)
 assert a['accepted']
 rows.append({'pipe_cells':cells,'temperature_k':temperature,'device':dev,'elapsed_s':elapsed,'model':m.to_dict(),'initial':s.to_dict(),'result':r,'independent_audit':a})
 print(dev,cells,temperature,elapsed,flush=True)
assert fingerprints()==hashes
p=Path('/tmp/open-pr-scale-'+dev+'.json');p.write_text(json.dumps({'source_sha256':hashes,'runtime':runtime_fingerprint(),'cases':rows,'qualification':'One observational timing per case, includes native coarse/two-half temporal control, excludes construction and independent scalar audit; fixed physical geometry. No Norne, field calibration or formal grid convergence claim.'},indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
limitations: Short synthetic gas FIM trajectory, not long-horizon field validation.
Two-phase and component-activation cases are standalone open surface tests, not calibrated oil/water FIM characterization.
Supported stirred external nodes; no open gravity/capillary-column/FIM bridge in this branch.
Empirical low-dP pressure ports, not general choking hardware.
Native equilibrium/slip models keep their prior physical domains; no globally validated regime map.
Dynamic injection well feedback and reservoir thermal PDE remain.
No external annular validation pass or experimental equipment/PVT calibration claimed.
Timings are one observation per case, no GPU speedup or Norne comparison claimed.
